content.text: {"label":"unknown_demand_surge","explanation":"General volume is well above forecast and climbing: +42% at 15:45, +59% at 16:00, with the alert showing +51%. AHT is near forecast, so this is a volume problem, not handling time or system slowness. The excess sits mainly in account_update (1.69x normal) and other_general (1.56x). No customer-facing incident is open, the marketing calendar is empty and no absences are logged, so the cause cannot be identified. Payments is overstaffed for its current load: 43 agents on phones against 35 planned, volume 12% below forecast, and service level at 100%.","plan_name":"Shift spare payments capacity to general, add a free break delay and a small evening overtime top-up","rationale":"General now carries about 30 Erlangs with 36 agents. If the surge keeps building toward ~95 calls per interval, it will need roughly 45 agents. Payments has spare capacity: about 25 Erlangs of load against 43 agents. Moving 5 cross-skilled agents is within the 30% donor cap and should keep payments well above 70%. Delaying general breaks from 16:30 to 17:30 is free and borrows extra cover for the peak; agents whose breaks were already delayed this morning will be skipped. The existing general overtime offer ends at 18:00, so a 4-agent offer for 18:00-20:00 covers the evening. It should cost about Rs 1,150 if 40% accept, which keeps cumulative overtime (about Rs 12,400 including this offer) inside the Rs 15,000 daily budget. Chat deflection of balance_enquiry on general is already running; the rising reasons are not eligible for deflection.
